name: Circuit of the Americas
coordinates: x east, z south, y up; meters
bank_convention: Positive bank raises the geometric left road edge relative to center

metadata.layout: Full 20-turn Grand Prix circuit (5.51 km), as used by MotoGP and Formula One; not the short National or Club layouts

start_finish.source: Transverse white line across the main straight at OSM node 7909207460 (raceway=start-finish), located in the USGS NAIP 2022 orthoimage; the painted grid slots are not discernible in the 0.6 m NAIP, so the line is identified from the OSM tag plus the imaged line

width.status: Published width; fewer than 40% of imagery edge measurements were plausible

elevation.name: USGS 3DEP elevation (resampled to 1 m)
elevation.bank: DEM cross slope between the measured edges, median and Gaussian smoothed, clamped to 8 degrees

imagery.name: USGS NAIP orthoimagery (Texas 2022, 0.6 m)
imagery.attribution: USGS, USDA, The National Map: Orthoimagery (NAIP)
imagery.acquisition: NAIP tile m_3009751_se_14_060_20220608 (acquired 2022-06-08), from the ImageServer catalog query

metadata.license: Open Database License 1.0 (ODbL) for OSM derived geometry, separate from repository MIT source code
metadata.attribution: OpenStreetMap contributors; USGS, USDA, The National Map: Orthoimagery (NAIP); U.S. Geological Survey, 3D Elevation Program
limitations: Centerline is OSM geometry recentred on imaged pavement, not a survey
Kerb positions come from imagery colour; kerb height reuses Thunderhill's provisional profile
Grip, run-off surfaces, walls and barriers are not modelled
